matchup.plan_md:
**Where things stand:**
- **Score after 19 Nov:** **900 to 878**, up 22.
- **Adds:** 3 of 7 used, **4 left**.
- **Projection with no more moves:** **1,670 to 1,576**.
- **Lineup over 20–22 Nov:** our side 770 with no moves; theirs 698.

**Research that moved the plan:**
- **Trey Murphy III** is **questionable** for Fri at OKC, upgraded from out on the official report ([NBA injury report, 19 Nov 10:45 PM ET](https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-11-19_10_45PM.pdf)). No timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 20 Nov.
- **Austin Reaves** is out Fri, and Quentin Grimes keeps starting ([RotoWire, 19 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/austin-reaves-injury-still-out-friday-540088)). With his role rate (36 min, ‡) Grimes drops below Mara.
- **Cade Cunningham** is probable Fri ([RotoWire, 19 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/cade-cunningham-injury-expected-to-play-friday-540045)). **Scottie Barnes** is off the report.
- **Myles Turner** is expected back Sat ([RotoWire, 19 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/myles-turner-injury-sidelined-by-left-shoulder-contusion-540024)), which ends Ware's start.
- **Rest risk on Sun 22, from patterns only:**
  - Paul George: two road second nights, sat both.
  - Kyrie Irving (theirs): sat 2 of 3 second nights.
  - Neemias Queta: rested 1 of 4 back-to-backs.

**The plans scored** (our lineup over 20–22 Nov; they score 698):

| Plan | Moves | Lineup | Final |
|---|---|---:|---|
| **Most points, keeping Murphy** | Ware → Murphy; Gobert → Mara → Queta; Bey → Buzelis (22 Nov) | **919** (817 + 102.0) | **about 1,819 to 1,576** |
| Most points, any route | Ware → Mara → Queta; Gobert → Murphy → Buzelis (22 Nov) | 918 (770 + 148.2) | about 1,818 to 1,576 |
| **User's plan** | Ware → Murphy; Gobert → Queen → Buzelis; Bey → Mara (22 Nov) | **911** (394 + 162 + 355) | about 1,811 to 1,576 |
| No moves | — | 770 | 1,670 to 1,576 |

The user's plan was scored day by day with `--swap ... --from --end`, on each day's roster.

**Verdict:**
- The best route is only **8 ahead** of the user's plan.
- Both keep Murphy and use all 4 adds.
- The 8 depends on Queta playing Sun 22, the second night of Boston's road back-to-back. The user's plan has Buzelis that night, and Buzelis has played every Bulls game, including both nights of two back-to-backs.
- **So it is a tie in practice, and the user's plan carries less Sunday risk.**

**The user's plan, with times** (Melbourne):
1. **20 Nov:** drop Ware (his next game is Sat). Add **Trey Murphy III** before NO @OKC (12:00 PM Sat 21).
   - He is questionable; if he is ruled out Fri, the margin still holds.
2. **20 Nov:** drop Gobert. Add **Derik Queen** before the same game.
3. **22 Nov:** drop Queen after NO @SA (tip-off 12:00 PM Sun 22). Add **Matas Buzelis** before CHI vs DEN (11:00 AM Mon 23).
4. **22 Nov:** drop Bey after NO @SA. Add **Aday Mara** before OKC @MIA (10:00 AM Mon 23).

**If Queta looks safe for Sunday** (no rest listed on Boston's report), the best route instead uses Gobert → Mara (20 Nov), Mara → Queta (21 Nov) and Bey → Buzelis (22 Nov).

- **Trey Murphy III** is **questionable** for Fri at OKC, upgraded from out ([NBA injury report, 19 Nov 10:45 PM ET](https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-11-19_10_45PM.pdf)); *ESPN est.* 20 Nov.
